EXG4-006.name: Distant Sea's Extreme
EXG4-006.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When your deck becomes zero due to opposing effects, you can immediately use this card, return every card in your Trash and all your banished cards to the deck and shuffle it. Also, during this turn, your deck is unaffected by opposing effects. These effects can't be prevented by either player's effects.

[Flash]
Except for on field effects, negate every opposing effect that is active, and immediately end this turn.
